name: Claudius
title: Tiberius Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus
summary: Tiberius Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, or Claudius, was a Roman emperor, ruling from AD 41 to 54. A member of the Julio-Claudian dynasty, Claudius was born to Drusus and Antonia Minor at Lugdunum in Roman Gaul, where his father was stationed as a military legate. He was the first Roman emperor to be born outside Italy.
notes: Reign: 13 years, 8 months and 19 days. Claudius had a limp and stutter, which may have led contemporaries to underestimate him. He wrote historical works (now lost) and promoted the use of Latin in the provinces. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claudius
